lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to World 22! Do you remember the old book from the tower? Today, we will walk down the stairs under the Tower of Messages. Down, down, down. Look! The walls are golden yellow. They're made of amber. This is the Amber Library. This library has a million books. Say it with me. This library has a million books. Wonderful! A million is a very big number. One thousand, one thousand, one thousand, a thousand times! There are old books on every shelf. The librarian is a wise old owl. His name is Professor Quill. Here is a sign at the door. Let's read it together. "Welcome to the Amber Library. We have a million books, and every book has a story inside. Please speak softly. You can borrow three books at a time. If you need help, ask Professor Quill." Now, phonics. When we add e r to an action word, it means a person. Write, writer. Read, reader. Paint, painter. Teach, teacher. A writer writes books, and a reader reads them. Today, you are all readers! Let's go inside.

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today, we're in the Picture Book Room. Every story has a main character. The main character (しゅじんこう) is the most important person or animal in the story. Look at this book. It's The Shy Dragon by Nora Bell. The main character is a shy dragon. Say it with me. The main character is a shy dragon. Very good! Then you can say more. His name is Ember. lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Last time, we used because to give a reason. Today, we will use so. So shows what happened next because of a feeling. He was scared, so he ran away. Say it with me. He was scared, so he ran away. Excellent! First the feeling, then so, then the action. Lulu was cold, so Ember made a fire. Now compare. He ran away because he was scared. He was scared, so he ran away. Same story, different order! Let's read a page from The Shy Dragon. "A long time ago, a hunter came to Ember's mountain. He had a loud horn and a big net. Ember was scared, so he ran away and hid in a deep cave. He stayed there for many days. Since that day, Ember was afraid of people. That's why he was so shy." lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today, we will read lines with feeling. The same words can sound very different. Listen. Oh no. That's sad. Oh no! That's surprised. Let's read it with feeling. Say it with me. Let's read it with feeling. Great! Books tell us how to read a line. Oh no! she cried sadly. Sadly means in a sad way. Oh no! he shouted in surprise. When you see sadly, read slowly and softly. When you see in surprise, read quickly and high. Let's read this short scene. "Mira's new robot fell off the table. Crash! 'Oh no!' she cried sadly. She picked up the pieces. Then Bolt rolled into the room with a box of tools. 'What happened?' asked Bolt. Mira smiled. 'We can fix it!' Two hours later, the robot stood up and waved. 'Hooray!' they shouted happily." How did Mira feel at first? Sad. And at the end? Happy! Now, phonics and reading. Oh no, exclamation. What happened, question. Hooray, exclamation. Let's read with feeling!

Once upon a time, there was a little fox. Say it with me. Once upon a time, there was a little fox. Lovely! Remember to change your voice for the lines. Hello, said the fox. At the end, say, The end. Then ask, Did you like the story? Let's practice with The Fox and the Moon. "Once upon a time, there was a little fox. Every night, he looked up at the moon. One night, the moon came down to the hill. 'Who are you?' asked the moon. 'Hello,' said the fox. 'I'm Fox. I'm your biggest fan!' The moon laughed. 'Look out! You're standing on my light!' Fox jumped. 'Are you okay?' The moon smiled. 'I'm fine. Let's be friends.' The end." Now, phonics and reading. Who are you, question mark. Look out, exclamation mark. Are you okay, question mark. Let's read it. "Three words open this book. The first word is what Ember found on the mountain. The second word is what Kai showed in the storm. The third word is what Mira uses every day to make new things. Say the three words together, and say them with feeling." Hmm. What did Ember find? A friend. So, friendship! Give a reason. I think the first word is friendship because Ember found a friend. What did Kai show? She was brave. Courage! And Mira? She has lots of ideas. Imagination! Now, phonics review. Writer. Action. Pencil. Famous. Okay, everyone. Let's say them together with feeling. Friendship! Courage! Imagination! Look! The book is opening!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today, we will write Book Recommendation Cards. We'll put them on the library board, so other readers can find great books. A good card has four parts. Title. What it's about. The main character. And why someone should read it. You should read it because it's exciting. Say it with me. You should read it because it's exciting. Excellent! You can add your favorite part. My favorite part is the ending. Let's read Riko's card. "Title: The Shy Dragon. Writer: Nora Bell. It's about a shy dragon and a lost girl. The main character is Ember. He's big, but he's gentle and shy. My favorite part is the ending, because everyone cheers for Ember. You should read it because it's warm and exciting. Rating: five stars!" That's a great card. It makes me want to read the book again. Now, phonics review. Artist. Protector. Second. Adventurous. Hooray! Write your title in big letters, and write five to eight sentences. Let's make our cards!
